reviews.text:
My wife has fallen in love with her bike now that she can easily mount and dismount her Tiger Relax MammaCangura child bicycle carrier. The quick release system is very user friendly. Our 2.5 year old daughter loves to ride in her seat and often takes a nap.
As new'er parents (2.5 and a 9 month old) we struggled to find an appropriate seat that was both safe and comfortable. The back rest with the oval cut out (top) is wonderfully ergonomical for the child's helmet. The Italians know how to make quality products.

I bought a MR FOX Relax for my grandson, and was very impressed with how easy it was to install the child bicycle carrier. He had a Topeak before but he didn’t like it and always complained how uncomfortable it was.  My wife and I wanted to share the one Mr. Fox Relax as we both have bikes so we ordered a second multifix bracket to easily transfer the bicycle carrier to her bike and much to our amazement, we received it from MammaCangura in less than 24 hours. Very impressed with the product,and the service. By the way, the price was great too. Lower than many other child bicycle carrier's we looked at online.

We bought a Freccia child carrier from MammaCangura for our 13 months old daughter.  She absolutely LOVED it!  We can't get her out of it without her crying!!  She loves the bike rides... which is good for my shape and my health!
With the Freccia seat, I feel that my child is safe, happy and comfortable.
Thank you MammaCangura!!

We got the B-Bip bike for our 2 year old. What a fab bike! No training wheels required when moving onto a big boy bike, really light, easy for him to steer, and no little fingers getting stuck in wheels. He loves it. Wished we'd known about it for our daughter! Great job Mamma Cangura

I recently bought a MammaCangura TIGER baby bike seat from Sports Experts and I have to say the product is truly amazing. My son Jacques loves it; he wants to ride his bike with me all the time. I had another one before, but... this one is such a difference! The Tiger seat is really comfortable, spacious, well-designed, with an adjustable backrest, super sturdy, and very safe with its 5-point harness. It's also very easy to install (seriously, guys, it takes less than 5 minutes!), and since we have two bikes at home, I saw that by buying another Multifix mount, available at Sports Experts, it takes 10 seconds to transfer the seat from my bike to my wife's. Fantastic, I'm thrilled! Pascal Dupuis, Magog, QC
